description: Is this record person-signed (ADR-003, decision 11)? For a record hosted here: its ownerSig must match the record's content (CID of the record without ownerSig) and verify with the openfederation_owner key in the author's DID document, over 'OpenFederation Owner Record v1' + did + collection + cid. No auth; same readability rules as reading the record.

main.description: Check whether a record carries a valid person signature.

ownerKey.description: The owner did:key the signature was checked against.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No such record here (or not readable by the caller).
